name: 808 glide bass
desc: Long-ringing sine 808 in C# minor with penv pitch glides sliding into every hit, a slowly breathing lpf, and a walking harmonic target note that alternates over four cycles.

code.full: note("db1 ~ ~ [~ db1] ~ ~ <e1 gb1 a1 gb1> ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(${glide}).pdec(.12).attack(.001).decay(1.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("db1 [~ db1] ~ db1 ~ [db1 e1] <a1 gb1> [~ <db2 b1>]").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(${glide}).pdec(.1).attack(.001).decay(1).sustain(.2).release(.1).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
